why: reviewer (minor): gram says nom. du. but the notes (and the translation 'the gods made you ...') take jātau as accusative in apposition with gopau; -au is nom./acc. alike, so the label contradicts the draft's own analysis.
reviewer (minor): After the split is corrected to juṣanta the tense label 'pres.' is wrong (juṣanta is the -anta injunctive/imperfect form). Apply this patch before the w patch below.
reviewer (error): Printed 'juṣante̱mau' (no hiatus) is juṣanta + imau (a+i = e); compare the hiatus form 'ma̭ i̱maṃ' (me imam) in 2.41.13. The split 'juṣante' + 'imau' does not reproduce the sandhi.
